caption: The drawing depicts a single closed book with a brown cover and a gold-toned spine and page edges, resting diagonally within a rectangular outlined frame. The book features a flap over the front cover, secured with a clasp, and the corners of the cover are slightly rounded. The fore-edge of the pages appears to have a reddish-pink tint. In the upper left corner, there is a small, gray rectangular label with cursive writing inside. In the lower right quadrant, a rectangular section shows the book’s title page with printed text that reads: "PSALMS AND HYMNS ADAPTED TO SOCIAL, PRIVATE, AND PUBLIC WORSHIP IN THE PRESBYTERIAN CHURCH IN THE U.S.A. PHILADELPHIA: S. C. ATKIN 1868." The background is plain and off-white, with light pencil outlines and minimal shading, and the artist’s name, "Emma Wilson," is written in small letters near the bottom left of the outlined frame.
title: Hymn Book
